headline: Apple Blames '100-Year Flood' in Memory Prices — And Hints the DRAM Market Needs More Competition
summary: Apple says soaring DRAM prices forced product price hikes, calls memory inflation a “100-year flood,” and hints the industry needs more suppliers.

headline: Trump’s Illegal Tariffs Delivered 85% of Apple’s Earnings Beat
summary: Apple posted a 15th straight earnings per share beat to analyst estimates in the third quarter. One surprising item may have helped with the beat.

headline: Apple Just Flagged a Headwind That Could Hit iPhone, Mac and iPad All at Once
summary: AAPL stock declines despite upbeat Q3 results. Analysts maintained Neutral/Hold ratings with price targets of $270-$300.

headline: Apple Stock Slump Could Just Be a Blip — Gene Munster Says Outlook 'Wasn’t as Bad as It Looked'
